scripts.pack:dev: pnpm run build && pnpm -F web run build:dev && pnpm -F roxybrowserdev run pack:dev
scripts.pack:prod: pnpm run build && pnpm -F web run build:prod && pnpm -F roxybrowserdev run pack:prod
scripts.publish:app:dev: pnpm run pack:dev && cross-env NODE_ENV=development tsx scripts/publish.ts
scripts.publish:app:prod: pnpm run pack:prod && cross-env NODE_ENV=production tsx scripts/publish.ts
scripts.publish:web:dev: pnpm -F web run build:dev && cross-env NODE_ENV=development pnpx tsx ./scripts/upload-web-source.ts
scripts.publish:web:dev:whitelist: pnpm -F web run build:dev && cross-env NODE_ENV=development pnpx tsx ./scripts/upload-web-source.ts --whitelist
scripts.publish:web:prod: pnpm -F web run build:prod && cross-env NODE_ENV=production pnpx tsx ./scripts/upload-web-source.ts
scripts.publish:web:prod:whitelist: pnpm -F web run build:prod && cross-env NODE_ENV=production pnpx tsx ./scripts/upload-web-source.ts --whitelist
scripts.publish:web:win:prod: pnpm -F web run build:prod && cross-env NODE_ENV=production PLATFORM=win pnpx tsx ./scripts/upload-web-source.ts
scripts.publish:app:mac:dev: pnpm -F roxybrowserdev run pack:app:mac:dev && pnpm run publish:app:dev:noPack
scripts.postinstall: npm run build:pkg && npm run install:electron
scripts.clean:cache: pnpx rimraf node_modules/.cache/ && pnpx rimraf node_modules/.vite
scripts.install:electron: cd apps/electron && cross-env ELECTRON_GET_USE_PROXY=true node node_modules/electron/install.js
scripts.agent:build: pnpm -F roxy-agent run build && pnpm -F @roxy/playwright run build && pnpm -F @roxy/openapi run build && pnpm -F roxy-skills run build
scripts.publish:agent:dev: pnpm agent:build && cross-env NODE_ENV=development pnpx tsx ./scripts/upload-agent.mts
scripts.publish:agent:prod: pnpm agent:build && cross-env NODE_ENV=production pnpx tsx ./scripts/upload-agent.mts
